name: TikTok Ads
label: TikTok Ads — Marketing API v1.3
description: TikTok Marketing API v1.3 at https://business-api.tiktok.com. Docs: https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs. Campaign/adgroup/ad use official named fields. pixel.track uses event_source + data[]. Header Access-Token. Handler: OfficialApiNode. Never log access_token or event user PII.
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: Per-operation fields. advertiser_id may come from config. Do not put access_token here. Example: {"operation":"campaign.list","advertiser_id":"123"}.

schema.label: operation
schema.description: Overrides config operation when non-blank. EXACT: advertiser.list | campaign.create | campaign.get | campaign.list | adgroup.create | adgroup.list | ad.create | ad.list | report.get | pixel.track | lead.list | trigger.listen.

schema.label: advertiser_id
schema.description: Advertiser id (string in v1.3). GET query can use config advertiser_id. POST body fields (create / pixel.track / lead.list) must be on INPUT.

schema.label: campaign_id
schema.description: Parent campaign id for adgroup.create.

schema.label: adgroup_id
schema.description: Parent ad group id for ad.create.

schema.label: campaign_name
schema.description: Name for campaign.create.

schema.label: adgroup_name
schema.description: Name for adgroup.create.

schema.label: ad_name
schema.description: Name for ad.create.

schema.label: objective_type
schema.description: Campaign objective. Example: TRAFFIC | LEAD_GENERATION | WEB_CONVERSIONS.

schema.label: budget_mode
schema.description: Budget mode as documented for the objective.

schema.label: budget
schema.description: Campaign or ad-group budget when required.

schema.label: creatives
schema.description: Creative payload for ad.create as /ad/create/ documents.

schema.label: filtering
schema.description: Provider filter object (ids, status) for list/get.

schema.label: page
schema.description: pixel.track page object {url, referrer}. Wired to data[0].page.

schema.label: page_size
schema.description: Page size; clamp to documented max.

schema.label: report_type
schema.description: report.get. Example: BASIC.

schema.label: data_level
schema.description: report.get. Example: AUCTION_CAMPAIGN | AUCTION_ADGROUP | AUCTION_AD.

schema.label: dimensions
schema.description: report.get dimension list.

schema.label: metrics
schema.description: report.get metric list.

schema.label: start_date
schema.description: report.get YYYY-MM-DD.

schema.label: end_date
schema.description: report.get YYYY-MM-DD.

schema.label: event_source
schema.description: pixel.track event_source. web | app | offline | crm. Required.

schema.label: event_source_id
schema.description: pixel.track pixel/app id. Required.

schema.label: data
schema.description: pixel.track one event object escape hatch merged into data[0]. Named event/event_time/event_id/user/properties/page win. Example: {"event":"CompletePayment","event_time":1710000000}.

schema.label: ad_id
schema.description: lead.list Instant Form ad id.

schema.label: page_id
schema.description: lead.list Instant Form page id.

schema.label: app_id
schema.description: Optional developer app id for advertiser.list query.

schema.label: operation_status
schema.description: Request-body parameter `operation_status` for operation: campaign.create.

schema.label: fields
schema.description: Query-string parameter `fields` for operations: campaign.get, campaign.list, adgroup.list, ad.list.

schema.label: placement_type
schema.description: Request-body parameter `placement_type` for operation: adgroup.create.

schema.label: bid_type
schema.description: Request-body parameter `bid_type` for operation: adgroup.create.

schema.label: optimization_goal
schema.description: Request-body parameter `optimization_goal` for operation: adgroup.create.

schema.label: location_ids
schema.description: Request-body parameter `location_ids` for operation: adgroup.create.

schema.label: tracking_pixel_id
schema.description: Request-body parameter `tracking_pixel_id` for operation: ad.create.

schema.label: test_event_code
schema.description: pixel.track test_event_code from Events Manager test tab. Omit for production.

schema.label: library_id
schema.description: Request-body parameter `library_id` for operation: lead.list.

schema.label: partner_name
schema.description: pixel.track partner_name when sending via a partner integration.

schema.label: event
schema.description: pixel.track Events API event name. Wired to data[0].event. Example: CompletePayment | PlaceAnOrder | ViewContent.

schema.label: event_time
schema.description: pixel.track unix seconds. Wired to data[0].event_time.

schema.label: event_id
schema.description: pixel.track dedup id. Wired to data[0].event_id.

schema.label: user
schema.description: pixel.track user object (hashed email/phone, ip, user_agent, …). Wired to data[0].user. Never log.

schema.label: properties
schema.description: pixel.track event properties {currency, value, …}. Wired to data[0].properties.

schema.label: billing_event
schema.description: Billing event for adgroup.create (e.g. CPC, CPM, OCPM).

schema.label: schedule_type
schema.description: Schedule type for adgroup.create (e.g. SCHEDULE_FROM_NOW, SCHEDULE_START_END).

schema.label: schedule_start_time
schema.description: Schedule start time for adgroup.create (UTC). Example: 2026-01-01 00:00:00.

ports.name: output
ports.description: Success: status=ok, http_status, data (provider JSON). Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: status
schema.description: Exact 'ok' on HTTP 2xx.

schema.label: http_status
schema.description: Upstream status code.

schema.label: data
schema.description: Provider JSON. May contain PII — never log values.

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: Default operation when input.operation is blank. EXACT: advertiser.list | campaign.create | campaign.get | campaign.list | adgroup.create | adgroup.list | ad.create | ad.list | report.get | pixel.track | lead.list | trigger.listen. trigger.listen is ingress.

configurationParameters.label: Access token
configurationParameters.description: TikTok Marketing API access token (StudioQuack secret). Sent as header Access-Token. Never log or place on INPUT. Developer portal: https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs

configurationParameters.label: Advertiser id
configurationParameters.description: Default advertiser_id (v1.3 string). Overridable on INPUT.

configurationParameters.label: Billing Event
configurationParameters.description: Billing event for adgroup.create (e.g. CPC, CPM, OCPM).

configurationParameters.label: Schedule Type
configurationParameters.description: Schedule type for adgroup.create (e.g. SCHEDULE_FROM_NOW, SCHEDULE_START_END).

configurationParameters.label: Schedule Start Time
configurationParameters.description: Schedule start time for adgroup.create (UTC). Example: 2026-01-01 00:00:00.

configurationParameters.label: Secret
configurationParameters.description: TikTok app secret for advertiser.list (/oauth2/advertiser/get requires app_id+secret). StudioQuack secret. Never log. Never put on INPUT.

configurationParameters.label: Timeout (seconds)
configurationParameters.description: Per-request HTTP timeout. Positive number; <=0 → 30. Keep below the daemon invoke budget.

configurationParameters.label: Webhook Key
configurationParameters.description: Engine Webhook API Key binding ($webhookKeyRef) routing inbound HTTP webhooks to this node.
